note.question: What role does privacy management play in service systems?
note.overview: This paper studies customer-centric privacy management in service systems. We explore the consequences of extended control over personal information by customers in such systems. We adopt a stylized queueing model to capture a service environment that features a service provider and customers who are strategic in deciding whether to disclose personal information to the service provider—that is, customers’ privacy or information disclosure strategy.
